title: System processes
guidance: Operating system processes. Never terminate them. If one of them is busy, report it and recommend a restart of the Mac.

title: Compilers and build tools
guidance: Compilers and linkers use every core and a lot of memory while a build runs. This is expected and ends by itself. The load is not a problem and nothing should be terminated.

title: Runaway CPU
guidance: A single non-system process that has used several cores for more than 30 seconds, and is not a build tool, is usually stuck. Terminating it is acceptable once a person approves.

title: Memory leak
guidance: A process whose memory keeps growing for minutes is leaking. Terminate that process once a person approves. Do not terminate processes whose memory is steady.

title: Disk nearly full
guidance: First stop the process that is writing at high speed, then purge temporary files. Never delete user documents.

title: Low battery
guidance: Plugging in the charger is the real fix. Ending a heavy video call or similar load slows the drain. Terminating that process is acceptable once a person approves.
